title: A spinner and bouncing dots
summary: Looping animations: a spinner with linear infinite, and three dots staggered with animation-delay.
explanation: The spinner is a circle with one coloured border side. @keyframes spin rotates it a full turn, and linear infinite repeats that at a constant speed forever: any easing would make it lurch.

The dots share one animation, but each starts a little later (animation-delay: 0, 150ms, 300ms), so they bounce one after another. alternate plays each cycle forwards then backwards, which makes the bounce smooth.
Loaders like these are decorative, so the @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block slows them right down for people who asked their system for less motion.
tryThis: Remove linear from the spinner: it speeds up and slows down each turn.
Set all three dot delays to 0: they bounce together.
Change infinite to 3 on the dots: they stop after three bounces.
